title: Time To The Half Hour Worksheets | 1st Math Practice Pack with Answer Key
desc:
📚 Common Core aligned: 1.MD.B.3

Give your learners extra practice with Time To The Half Hour! This no-prep printable pack has 3 practice pages plus a 1-page answer key for grown-ups. Just print and go.

WHAT'S INSIDE (6 pages)

  • Cover page
  • Half Past
  • Half Past in Words
  • Half an Hour Later
  • Answer key (1 page): every answer, plus "Say" lines for listening pages
  • Terms of use

PERFECT FOR

  • Morning work, centers and small groups
  • Homework, early finishers and review
  • Homeschool lessons and summer practice

WHY TEACHERS LOVE IT

  • Clear directions young learners can follow
  • Friendly pictures that match each word
  • Listening pages keep the words in the answer key, so children truly listen
  • Each page matches a game on Creative Sprout Learning (Half Past, Half Past in Words, Half an Hour Later), so children can play, then print and practice

💰 SAVE MORE: this pack is part of the Math Bundle and the Mega Bundle.
